name: Cure Wounds
entries: A creature you touch regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 2d8|1-9|2d8} for each spell slot level above 1.
